info.title: Fenergo Nebula Association Query
info.description:
**Association Query API**:


Association Query API provides endpoints in order to retrieve entity associations.


**Association Query API provides**:
  • Entity Association retrieval
  • Unwrapping Requirement Status Model Management

post.summary: Get a page of an entity's direct children in the entity-ownership hierarchy
post.description:
Returns a single page of the direct children of the given entity, ordered by a stable internal key (not creation time or any other client-meaningful order). This one endpoint serves the first render of the root entity's children, a Branch Card drill-in into any other node's children, and continuation paging for a node whose children have already been partially shown - all three are simply a call against the relevant entityId, with or without a paginationToken carried over from a previous response. Takes its parameters as a JSON request body (replacing a previous GET/query-string version of this endpoint) so further parameters (e.g. taskId, a stable rootEntityId/parentEntityId pair) can be added without another breaking change to the query string.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: AssociationAccess

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

Optional journey id. When supplied, verified associations and current-journey draft associations

pageSize.description: The maximum number of children to return in this page. Defaults to 100.

paginationToken.description:
Token from a previous response's NextPaginationToken, to resume after the last item previously
returned. Must have been issued for this exact entityId and journeyId - a token issued for a
different entity or journey is rejected.

includeOwnChildCount.description:
When true, the response's OwnChildCount also reports entityId's own child count. Defaults to false -
callers should only set this for a node whose count they don't already know some other way.

childCount.description:

HierarchyChildNodeDto.description:

Fenergo.Nebula.Association.Query.Application.Dto.HierarchyChildNodeDto.ParentId is the entity whose children were requested.

RelationshipContexts.description:
Identifies the relationship context for a related party in the RPD&D task.
Defined as a flags enum so that Fenergo.Nebula.Association.Query.Application.Enums.RelationshipContexts.Both is a true bitwise combination
of Fenergo.Nebula.Association.Query.Application.Enums.RelationshipContexts.Hierarchy and Fenergo.Nebula.Association.Query.Application.Enums.RelationshipContexts.InvestmentAccount, allowing callers
to use `HasFlag` to test individual origins.

entityId.description: The UiD of the root entity.

associationTypes.description: Types of associations to search for.

edgeDirection.description:
Edge direction - default inbound-outbound
inbound - only inbound edges leading to root entity will be searched
outbound - only outbound edges from root will be searched
inbound-outbound - inbound and outbound edges will be searched

inboundEdgeTraversalLimit.description: Limits search traversal of inbound edges to specified association type.

outboundEdgeTraversalLimit.description: Limits search traversal of outbound edges to specified association type.

entityId.description: The UiD of the root entity.

journeyId.description:
The UiD of the journey.
If not provided, only the verified associations will be returned.
If provided, unverified associations in the given journey and 
all the verified associations will be returned.

associationTypes.description:
Types of associations to search for.
If not provided, all types of associations will be returned.

edgeDirection.description:
Edge types - default inbound-outbound.
inbound-outbound - inbound and outbound edges will be searched.
inbound - only inbound edges leading to root entity will be searched.
outbound - only outbound edges from root will be searched.
If A is the root entity and edgeDirection is outbound, A-->B will be returned.
If A is the root entity and edgeDirection is inbound, A<-C will be returned.
If A is the root entity and edgeDirection is inbound-outbound, A-> B and A<-C will be returned.

allowedInboundAssociationTypesForTravers.description:
The allowed association types of inbound edges for traversal.
If not provided, all association types for inbound edges during traversal will be accepted.
If we have two associations A<--Shareholder---B, A<---collateral---C, and root entity is A,
AllowedInboundAssociationTypesForTraversal: ["Shareholder"], then only A<--Shareholder---B will be returned.

allowedOutboundAssociationTypesForTraver.description:
The allowed association types of outbound edges for traversal.
If not provided, all association types for outbound edges during traversal will be accepted.
If we have two associations A--Shareholder--->B, A---collateral--->C, and root entity is A,
AllowedOutboundAssociationTypesForTraversal: ["collateral"], then only A---collateral--->C will be returned.

excludeRootIds.description:
When true, the RelatedPartyRootIds attribute is excluded from the returned associations.
Defaults to false (root ids are included).

maxAssociations.description:
Optional cap on the number of associations returned. When set (greater than 0), at most this
many associations are returned - protecting callers that invoke this query synchronously from
the AWS Lambda 6 MB response-size limit (a super-connected entity can otherwise exceed it and
fail with Function.ResponseSizeTooLarge). When null or not provided, all associations are returned.
